facts.claim: Rome's contributo di soggiorno is charged per person per night by hotel class: €10 at five-star, €7.50 at four-star, €6 at three-star, €5 at two-star and €4 at one-star hotels, €3.50 at hostels, and €5 to €7 at guest houses, B&Bs, holiday homes and short-term rentals; these rates apply from 1 October 2023 (Giunta Capitolina deliberation 255 of 17 July 2023) and are still the current ones listed by Roma Capitale in October 2026.

facts.claim: Florence's imposta di soggiorno is charged per person per night: €8 at five-star, €7 at four-star, €6 at three-star, €4.50 at two-star and €3.50 at one-star hotels, €7 at residenze d'epoca, €6 at B&Bs, affittacamere, holiday flats (CAV) and short-term tourist rentals, and €4 at youth hostels and case per ferie; these rates were approved by Giunta deliberation 535 of 10 December 2024, apply from 1 February 2025, and are still the current ones listed by the Comune di Firenze in October 2026.

facts.claim: Since 30 July 2024 (Council deliberation 57/2024, safeguard measures) Florence has barred new short-term tourist rentals in the UNESCO historic core (Zone A1); from 21 June 2026 (DCC 28 of 4 June 2026) no new short-term rental activity may start in Zone A subzones A1, A3 and A4; every short-term rental needs a five-year municipal authorisation under the regulation in force since 31 May 2025, with units already let in 2024 exempt for three years.

facts.claim: Tram line T2 links Florence's Peretola airport with the city centre in about 20 minutes; the Peretola Aeroporto stop is a 2-minute walk from arrivals; first tram from the airport 05:00, last 23:58 Sunday to Thursday and 01:15 Friday and Saturday. The line opened on 11 February 2019 from Peretola to Piazza Unità, beside Santa Maria Novella station.

facts.claim: Venice's 2026 access fee trial applied on 60 days from 3 April to 26 July 2026, between 8:30am and 4pm, to the historic city only (not the minor islands such as Lido, Murano, Burano); €5 if paid by the fourth day before access, €10 after; it ended and has not applied since 27 July 2026, and the city has not set any 2027 dates.
